newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.981 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.981 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended Feb 8 was 4,981,005 gallons compared with 5,875,219 gallons last week.
Imports were 520,301 gallons compared with 301,991 gallons the previous week. There were no domestic receipts this week compared to 6,757 the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,138,266 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,386,889 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 51,260,061 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 129,521,004 gallons.
